name: Promise
source:
A girl suddenly appears before the main character reminding him of the youth promise to marry her. Whether he accepts those feelings or gets drown in a whirlpool of temptations, is up to him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名少女突然出现在主人公面前，提醒他年轻时曾许诺娶她。是接受这份感情，还是沉入诱惑的漩涡，都由他自己决定。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
